name: figure6_public_table_v1
scope: Environment acceptance only; not a new full-method paper benchmark

table_visual.source: Public table.urdf and table.obj, unchanged since before paper; transform from public Kinova tabletop example, NOT recovered FR3 directive

coordinate_convention: FR3 base at origin, x forward, z up, robot right=-y and left=+y; paper world axes unpublished

evidence.forest_reference: 15 circles and displayed trajectory endpoints recovered from author Figure 6 vector artwork, frame affinely mapped to [-5,5]^2; original benchmark seed list remains unknown
evidence.forest_random: Reuse v5's 10 obstacle realizations (default_rng seeds 0..9) under the paper's 15/r=.35/central7m/square10m parameters, with endpoints now taken from Figure 6. These are changed conditions on familiar scenes, not new seeds or held-out tasks
evidence.table: Public author's table asset is a stronger source than prior arbitrary box. Its FR3 use and translation remain hypotheses. Visual is 1.5m; collision is deliberately the released 2.5m box, no colliding legs added
evidence.obstacle_height: Figure 6 includes black spheres intersecting tabletop. Uniform center z support changed to [0,.8] to admit that relation. Law and numeric endpoints are inferred, not published
evidence.obstacle_xy_radius: 20 from paper; r=.05 and x=[.25,.75], y=[-.4,.4] retained declared reconstruction choices, not measured 3D coordinates
evidence.robot: Existing conservative 33-sphere fit of pinned official FR3 geometry and official pair filters retained; author sphere placement/filter unavailable
evidence.tasks: First collision-free joint-uniform configuration in right TCP box; independent joint-uniform FK pushforward pose in left box. No downward-orientation restriction, no selection by planner/optimizer outcome. Target witness is not the online IK initial guess
evidence.streams: Reuse declared v5 obstacle and endpoint PRNG stream identifiers for paired environment changes. These are not author seeds
unknowns: original 10 environment seeds and task list
sphere radius and exact sampling volume
original KUKA/RealSense physical scene and records
